seo.og_title: Asnaa Hot Springs, Dakhla: Desert Thermal Waters & Relaxation
seo.og_description: Relax in the natural warm sulfur waters of Asnaa hot springs, located just inland from the Dakhla lagoon.

name: Asnaa Hot Springs
hero_subtitle: Natural warm thermal waters in the desert interior — a soothing escape after wind, salt and sand.

overview.title: Thermal wellness in the Sahara
overview.p1: Located roughly 30 kilometers inland from Dakhla, the Asnaa hot springs offer a unique contrast to the coastal lagoon and ocean waves. Water gushes from underground at a steady, soothing temperature around 38°C to 40°C.
overview.p2: Rich in sulfur and minerals, the water is traditionally valued for its relaxing properties, soothing tired muscles after kitesurfing and nurturing skin health.
overview.p3: Surrounded by open desert landscape, visiting the springs provides a peaceful and restorative retreat during your Dakhla adventure.

gallery.title: Asnaa Hot Springs in Pictures
gallery.subtitle: Swipe through warm desert waters and surrounding landscapes.

tips.title: Practical Tips for Visiting Asnaa Hot Springs

1.title: Transportation
1.desc: A taxi or 4x4 rental is recommended as the springs are located off the main paved roads in the desert interior.

2.title: What to Bring
2.desc: Pack a towel, spare change of clothes, and water. Note that sulfur water has a distinct natural mineral scent.

3.title: Combining Visits
3.desc: The springs can easily be paired with a desert excursion or combined on the way to or from the White Dune.

q1.question: Are Asnaa Hot Springs free to visit?
q1.answer: Yes, accessing the natural spring site is generally free, though transport costs apply if hiring a taxi or 4x4 from Dakhla.

q2.question: What temperature is the water at Asnaa Hot Springs?
q2.answer: The water emerges from underground at a constant, soothing warmth of around 38°C to 40°C, rich in sulfur and minerals.

q3.question: What are the health benefits of the springs?
q3.answer: The sulfur-rich mineral water is traditionally valued for soothing skin conditions, relaxing sore muscles, and relieving joint tension.

q4.question: How far are the hot springs from Dakhla town?
q4.answer: The springs are located about 30 kilometers inland from Dakhla, roughly a 30 to 40-minute drive across the desert terrain.

q5.question: What should I bring when visiting?
q5.answer: Bring a towel, change of clothes, water to stay hydrated, and footwear suitable for sandy or damp ground around the pool.
